# Soul Blueprint
> Soul Blueprint (Vedic Sky Observer) is a sidereal Vedic astrology web app at https://thesoulblueprint.online. It offers three free birth-chart reports (career, personality, daily energy) with no account required, plus an optional private workspace for sky maps, dashas, AI chat, and saved charts. Calculations use Lahiri ayanamsa and precision astronomy; interpretive text is generated by Gemini.

Important notes for agents:

- **Public vs private:** `/`, `/career`, `/personal`, `/daily`, `/gift`, `/privacy`, and `/terms` are public. Authenticated routes (`/sky`, `/kundli`, `/insights`, `/chat`, etc.) require sign-in. Do not assume access to user data without credentials.
- **Astrology system:** Sidereal (Vedic), not tropical Western. Positions use Lahiri ayanamsa. Swiss Ephemeris on the server; client-side math in `vedic-utils` for yogas, dashas, panchang, divisional charts.
- **Free reports:** Users enter birth date, time, and place. Reports are generated on demand and may be shared via opaque IDs at `/career/r/:id`, `/personal/r/:id`, `/daily/r/:id` — treat shared report URLs as user content, not site documentation.
- **Birth data:** Birth details are personal data. See [privacy policy](https://thesoulblueprint.online/privacy) before storing or repeating user-supplied birth information.
- **Contact:** hello@vedicsky.app

- [Overview & terminology](https://thesoulblueprint.online/llms/overview.md): What the product is, how calculations work, key terms
- [Homepage](https://thesoulblueprint.online/): Landing page with product summary and sign-up

## Free reports (no account)

- [Free reports guide](https://thesoulblueprint.online/llms/free-reports.md): Inputs, outputs, and use cases for all three calculators
- [Career path report](https://thesoulblueprint.online/career): Work fit, timing windows, professional strengths from birth chart
- [Personality blueprint](https://thesoulblueprint.online/personal): Inner vs outer self, motivations, life themes
- [Daily energy report](https://thesoulblueprint.online/daily): Today's mood/energy and 7-day emotional weather forecast

## Authenticated workspace

- [Workspace features](https://thesoulblueprint.online/llms/workspace.md): Sky map, kundli, insights dashboard, AI chat, dashas, divisional charts, journal — requires account
- [Sign in / sign up](https://thesoulblueprint.online/?auth=signup): Create a profile from the homepage

## Gift

- [Gift a reading](https://thesoulblueprint.online/gift): Send a sidereal birth-chart reading as a gift link
